services.name: Begin Fencing
services.desc: Anyone new to NYFA begins with Introductory Lessons with one of our expert coaches. Simply call to book your lessons & begin fencing! BEGINNERS: If you’ve never fenced before or have less than six months experience, start with an Introductory Package of private lessons. You will learn proper fencing position, how to hold the weapon, how to make correct touches, and how to do a basic attack. We recommend two or four lessons a week for two weeks. Then you’ll be ready to join our ongoing group classes safely and with confidence. Equipment is provided. You can take one private lesson before starting a package if you prefer. services.name: Afterschool Programs
services.desc: NYFA has fun afterschool classes especially designed to introduce school groups to the great sport of fencing. Our flexible programs can be scheduled at our clubs or at your school. Classes are taught by experienced coaches, and are equipped with everything needed. Students may continue in this program for recreational fencing or may join our regular classes in Brooklyn or Long Island for more competitive training. Bambi Academy, Bayville Elementary, Portledge School, PS 316, and Packer Collegiate Institute are some of the fantastic schools that we work with.
